origin: KiCad schematics by the maintainer, exported for ngspice, and variants of them made for M14, each changing one form
author: xdylanm
notes: Linear dependent sources and switches for M14. A variant's second line says what it changes. The intentional failures are in elements_rejects. M15 added B and the nonlinear forms, with variants written from these files; the files of M15b's forms are skipped by the solver sweep until then. Provenance confirmed by the maintainer, 2026-11-06.
